synopsis: The corpus identifies InVerS as a Fraunhofer ITWM research project focused on construction-site digital twins [f8694, f16078]. Chapter 11 describes its simulation scope as integrating “sensor data acquisition to alerting machine operators” [f8819]. The glossary places InVerS among off-road-relevant research and military programs, alongside RODOS, VMC and Duality Falcon associated with DARPA RACER-Sim [f16078]. The supporting institute pages are explicitly classified as vendor evidence; the supplied facts provide no independent validation results, costs or availability dates for InVerS [f8694, f8819, f16078].
